# watchpoint_environment (Data Source)

Looks up an environment by key, for example to place monitors in an environment managed outside this configuration. Pass `default` to get the tenant's default environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_environment" "default" {
  key = "default"
}

resource "watchpoint_ping_monitor" "edge" {
  name           = "Edge router"
  hostname       = "203.0.113.10"
  environment_id = data.watchpoint_environment.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Environment key (case-insensitive), or `default` for the default environment.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Chip color.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the tenant's default.
- `is_production` (Boolean) Whether it is marked production.
- `monitor_count` (Number) Live monitors in the environment.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `service_count` (Number) Services in the environment.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position in pickers and filters.
